title: Observational Monocentric Study on Biliary Tract Cancer (BABEL)
official: The Prognostic and Predictive Role of Clinical, Biochemical, Pathological and Molecular Characteristics of Patients With Biliary Tract Cancer: an Observational Monocentric Study. (BABEL)
summary: BABEL is an observational, single-center, prospective study about patients affected by biliary tract cancers (BTC) treated at the Medical Oncology Unit of the FPUAG - IRCCS.
sponsor: Fondazione Policlinico Universitario Agostino Gemelli IRCCS
